name: MLE-bench
description: A benchmark evaluating AI agents on 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions, testing the complete ML engineering workflow from data exploration and feature engineering to model training and submission. Agents must compete in real competition environments with fixed time and compute budgets. Measures whether AI can perform end-to-end ML research and engineering.
evaluation_method: competition performance (percentile rank against human competitors)
general_score_metric: percentile rank against human Kaggle competitors
typical_sota_score: Bronze medal performance on ~20–30% of competitions (frontier agents as of 2024–2025)
reputation: Novel benchmark connecting AI capability to real competitive ML tasks; developed by OpenAI; demonstrates frontier AI capability in end-to-end ML workflows; published 2024
notes: Tests the full ML engineering lifecycle: dataset analysis, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and ensemble methods. Agents are given competition datasets and must achieve competitive scores. Frontier agents (GPT-4, Claude) can reach bronze medal performance on a subset of competitions. Published 2024 by OpenAI.
